motif_call.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: simplified motif template for later nonogram rasterization, NOT a completion illustration and NOT a grid. Image 1 is the APPROVED reveal A-r01 and the sole edit target/source. Derive a substantially simplified clean flat 2D shape illustration from this exact Chupacabra. Preserve its identity, head and body proportions, face pointing left in the same three-quarter view, upright hunched pose, two long arms held in front, two bent hind legs and feet, large pointed ears, red eyes and short fangs, continuous dorsal spine row and long tail curving to the right into an open loop. Keep the original composition and relative positions of all main body parts. No redesign, different pose, additions, ground, text, grid or pixels. Target later readability around 31 columns x 40 rows. Use ONLY FOUR solid foreground colors: dark forest green #26352b for outer contours, dorsal spines, claws and face marks; olive green #6c7f3a for body; warm ochre #c5a45e for belly, throat, muzzle and fangs; warm red #c9462e for eyes. True transparent background, including genuine spaces between arms, legs and inside the tail loop. Remove ALL scales, stippling, wrinkles, gradients, painted shading, highlights and tiny marks. Merge small interior areas into large solid connected shapes. Retain roughly 9-12 chunky well-separated dorsal spikes as a simplified version of the existing spine row, two simple red eye marks, broad muzzle/ochre belly, thick readable limbs. Simplify each hand/foot to a few broad claw shapes; eliminate hairline-separated fingers and double outlines. Use strong clean continuous dark-green contours and a handful of functional inner boundaries. No black, white, fifth color, shadows or decoration. Whole creature visible. This is a graphic abstraction of the approved file, not a new character.

original_A_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: detailed full-color completion illustration for a hand-drawn nonogram game. Create ONE original interpretation of a Chupacabra, single full-body cryptid, no other subjects. Warm, calm, characterful hand-drawn 2D illustration with confident clean dark contours, solid substantial colored shapes, thoughtfully drawn anatomy, selective small skin details and restrained painted shading. Clear readable silhouette, real detail beyond a flat icon. Eerie and curious, not baby-cute. Reptilian mammalian cryptid with red eyes, tapered muzzle, two modest visible fangs, muscular bent hind legs, clawed hands and feet, prominent row of thick pointed dorsal spines. NO wings, clothing, props, blood, dead animals, text, labels, watermarks, grid, pixel art, 3D, photorealism. Isolated on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, also transparency in real holes between limbs. Entire creature fits with narrow comfortable margins; no ground plane, white rectangle, cast shadow or decorative backdrop. Rounded purposeful contours and readable negative spaces that could later support abstraction. Pose: upright alert three-quarter view facing left, compact hunched pear-shaped torso with bent large hind legs, arms loosely held in front, head turned slightly toward viewer, visible spine row from back of head down back, thick tail gently curling around to the right. Palette: moss and olive green body, warm pale ochre throat and belly, dark forest green back spines, small rust-red eyes. Full body balanced compact vertical composition.
